description: Asks to send a copy of every email arriving on the signed-in user's aliases to an https:// webhook URL. Nothing changes yet: the user gets a confirmation link, by email or, for accounts made in Telegram, in their chat with the HideMail bot, and the webhook is set only after they confirm it there. Tell the user where to look: the response says which.

url.description: The https:// URL that should receive a copy of every incoming email, for example "https://hooks.example.com/hidemail".

name: request_webhook
title: Request webhook
